# TODO Entry Template

**Document ID:** TEMPLATE-TODO-ENTRY

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** roadmap/status

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** template for one formally promoted TODO.md entry

**Surface:** template

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** non-normative

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** exclude

Add an entry to `TODO.md` only after an explicit owner decision. Link the
source decision or evidence instead of copying it.
The roadmap owns rationale, accepted scope and criteria; this entry owns
the work needed to reach that outcome and its execution gates.

```text
### `PXL-TODO-001` — Short imperative title

**Status:** promoted
**Source:** owner decision on YYYY-MM-DD, or a link to the proposal, finding, issue, or archive record
**Accepted scope:** link to the accepted ROADMAP phase
**Work:** what remains to be done for that outcome
**Dependencies and gates:** numbered list, or none
**Completion criteria:** link to the phase's acceptance criteria
**Breakdown:** TASKLIST.md section link, or none
```

When complete, remove the active entry. Preserve the roadmap block, outcome,
evidence links and planning commit in one closure; do not copy task lists.
Use the [closure template](CLOSURE-RECORD.md). A direct owner instruction can
authorize work; record its accepted scope without inventing prior planning.
